# Bob Nguyen — Account Manager, Cascade Castings

> Note: there are **two Bobs** in Ray's orbit. This is **Bob Nguyen**, our **supplier contact at
> Cascade Castings** (ductile-iron castings). The other is [Bob Petrakis](bob-petrakis.md), who
> runs the Rockford plant. Do not conflate them.

- **Relationship:** external. Our account manager at **Cascade Castings**, the effectively
  **single-source** supplier of ductile-iron castings for Brandt's pumps and valves.
- **Cadence:** monthly supply review with VP Ops [Terrence Boyd](terrence-boyd.md).
- **Distinguishing fact:** casting lead time (~**11 weeks**) is the binding constraint on the
  [HydraFlow line launch](../projects/hydraflow-line-launch.md); Bob is the lever on expediting.
- **Company:** Cascade Castings, a foundry in Indiana; ~60% of our castings spend.

## How to work with him
- Relationship-driven; a personal call from Terrence moves faster than a PO escalation.
- Has floated a capacity-reservation agreement to de-risk the single-source exposure.

## Sensitivities / risk
- **Single-source risk:** a Cascade outage would stall pump and valve production network-wide.
  Dual-sourcing castings is an open action for Terrence.
